summary: The user module manages accounts and attributes using platform tools: useradd/usermod/userdel generally, dscl on macOS, pw on FreeBSD, and BusyBox adduser/deluser. Windows uses win_user.
questions: How do I create a Linux user with Ansible?
What commands does the user module use under the hood?
How are users managed on macOS by Ansible?
How do I manage Windows users?

answer_card.title: Manage user accounts
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.user` manages accounts using:
- Linux: `useradd`/`usermod`/`userdel`
- macOS: `dscl`, `dseditgroup`
- FreeBSD: `pw`, `chpass`
- BusyBox: `adduser`, `chpasswd`, `deluser` (`move_home` needs `shadow`)

Shadow files are backed up. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_user`.
